subject.title: Sub-agent run timeout does not notify parent session (completion event silently dropped)

question: Should the remaining no-deliverable-payload parent-wake fix proceed through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96189, or should this umbrella be redirected to a broader durable-announcement design first?
rationale: The wait-layer race is already fixed on main, but the remaining delivery behavior affects session state, external message delivery, and possible synthesized notice contents, so automation should not choose the permanent delivery policy or sequencing alone.

options.title: Keep This Umbrella For The Delivery Fix
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96189 or an equivalent no-payload delivery fix lands with focused tests and live parent-wakeup proof.

options.title: Route To Durable Announcement Design
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94153 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90178 as the canonical remaining design if maintainers want persisted completion delivery instead of the narrower synthesized-notice repair.

options.title: Split The Umbrella
options.body: Close only after creating narrower canonical trackers for the no-output direct-message, announce give-up, and transcript/tool_result pairing variants.

recommendation.title: Keep This Umbrella For The Delivery Fix
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96189 or an equivalent no-payload delivery fix lands with focused tests and live parent-wakeup proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has substantial subagent announce history and provided the latest reopen instruction tying closure to delivery-layer tests and live proof.
